question: Does growth by NAE-faithful moves supply the count of how knots meet (two per pair, one link per distinction, six per distinction), or must each part be put in?

definitions.move: Propose {x,y,z} on a co-knotted pair, z existing with probability b else new; keep it if legal under the rule and NAE still reads the world faithfully (KNOTS-ALONE's read_law_sat, knots_alone.py sha256 aee9a2eda0907064b89eae4fe4badddb22b80fecb62bd91d5a5fa448397010de).
definitions.rules: free: any co-knotted pair; open: pairs in one knot, every pair in at most two knots; disc: that and every link a single path or cycle.
definitions.runs: rules x b in {0.3, 0.6, 0.9} x seeds 0..9 x laws {NAE, OR}: 180 runs; stop at 80 knots or 400 rejections in a row; seed 1000 rule + 100 bias + seed + 20261115.
definitions.readings: pairs by number of knots, pinched links, closed distinctions (link a single cycle) and their degrees, closings accepted and rejected by degree, closed surfaces and Euler characteristic.

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 a6256cb81c16803fc2a1b4af3e3440dd124352b55e67b93bd78e170f3c9fc504) beside this file; KNOTS-ALONE's knots_alone.py; pysat Minisat22; 12 workers.
public_inputs.run: census.py from the repository root; output artifacts/GROW-COUNT-20261111-001A/GROW-COUNT-20261111-001A-E001_count_from_growth/census.json and census_log.txt.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the rules, biases, seeds, sizes, laws or predictions after seeing results
primary_observable: Per rule under NAE against OR: pairs in three or more knots, pinched links, closing degrees, rejected closings by degree.
cheapest_meaningful_control: The clause law as the frozen comparison arm (accepts every legal move); a pilot with seeds 98 and 99 outside the registered seeds, disclosed; the coverage check fails in control mode.

predictions.P1: free NAE: every run has a pair in three or more knots.
predictions.P2: open NAE: some run has a pinched link.
predictions.P3: disc NAE: closed degrees take at least three values and no run has degree 6 at 90% or more.
predictions.P4: disc NAE: no flat closed surface.
predictions.P5: disc NAE: every proposal that would close a link at degree 3 is rejected.

decision_rules.P1-P3 hold: Faithful growth does not supply the count; each part is put in (A64).
decision_rules.P3 fails: NAE chooses flatness given the pair count and the link; stress test before reading it.
decision_rules.P1 or P2 fails: That part comes from the law.

runtime: About a quarter of an hour on 12 workers; registered; systemd-run --user -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0.
